task_instance: Bootstrap Mode: generate a company-specific data analysis skill ('acme-data-analyst') for a fictional Snowflake warehouse (ACME_PROD.ANALYTICS) from a simulated analyst interview (input_interview.md), producing SKILL.md plus references/entities.md, references/metrics.md, references/tables/subscriptions_and_billing.md, and references/tables/product_usage.md, following the skill's Phase 3 structure and Quality Checklist.
blocker_detail: The skill also mentions using live '~~data warehouse' MCP query/schema tools for live schema discovery (Phase 1) and packaging the final output as a .zip file (Phase 4). Neither is available in this runtime (no MCP/connector tools permitted, no code execution to zip files), so those two sub-steps were not performed. This did not block the core deliverable: the analyst-knowledge interview was captured as a text document standing in for the live conversation/schema-discovery step, and the tailored skill (SKILL.md + reference files) was fully authored as plain text/Markdown, matching the skill's required structure and quality checklist, and delivered as an unzipped folder rather than a .zip archive.
evidence: Files created under the work directory: input_interview.md (simulated Phase 1/2 analyst answers: warehouse type, key tables, entity disambiguation for customer vs user, primary identifiers including legacy-ID caveats, formulas for ARR/NRR/WAU, standard exclusion filters, and common gotchas); acme-data-analyst/SKILL.md (complete frontmatter with name+description, Knowledge Base Navigation section linking every reference file, standard filters block, top-gotchas list); acme-data-analyst/references/entities.md (Customer and User entities with definition, primary table, ID fields, relationships, common filters, and the 'per-customer not per-user' mistake called out); acme-data-analyst/references/metrics.md (ARR, NRR, WAU each with definition, exact SQL formula, source tables, caveats); acme-data-analyst/references/tables/subscriptions_and_billing.md and .../tables/product_usage.md (each with Location, Description, Primary Key, Update Frequency, a Key Columns table, Relationships, and 2-3 sample Snowflake SQL queries). Verified against the skill's own Quality Checklist: frontmatter present, entity disambiguation clear, terminology defined, standard filters documented, >=2 sample queries per table/domain, Snowflake-dialect SQL used consistently, and all reference files are linked from SKILL.md's navigation section. The only unmet sub-steps are the live warehouse-connector discovery (no MCP data-warehouse tool was available/permitted) and zip packaging (no code execution available to produce a binary archive); the generated skill content itself is a complete, verifiable deliverable as plain text files.
